name: M43

provenance.source: FEMM 4.2 material library matlib.dat, block "M-43 Steel" (47 BH points, 45 used; d_lam 0.635 mm). Typical catalogue curve; points above about 2.0 T are FEMM's own extrapolation, not measurements. Points above 2.2 T (FEMM extrapolation with dB/dH below mu0) are dropped; the saturation tail covers them.

saturation_polarisation_source: PROVISIONAL: typical room-temperature value for Fe-Si non-oriented steel (Bozorth, Ferromagnetism, 1951); replace with the supplier value (spec §10)
density_source: PROVISIONAL: typical non-oriented Fe-Si value, not checked against a datasheet (spec §10)
